origine_fr: Le bois 木 et 佥, qui donnait le son mais se lit qiān. Au départ, 检 est l'étiquette d'un document, fermée par un cachet. On vérifie le cachet : de là « examiner, vérifier ».
origine_en: Wood 木 with 佥, which gave the sound but is read qiān. At first, 检 was the label on a document, closed with a stamp. You check the stamp: hence “to inspect, to check”.

phrase.pinyin: Yīshēng gěi wǒ jiǎnchá le shēntǐ.
phrase.en: The doctor gave me a check-up.
